experiment.title: Two-seed fresh 14-bit sampled typed-TT locator replication
experiment.objective: Replicate the fresh p16267 sampled typed-TT locator signal on two independently generated 14-bit ordinary prime-field curves using the same matched Pollard-rho and held-out rank protocol.
stopping_rules: classify timeout or memory exhaustion as infrastructure evidence
invalidation_rules: do not treat a failed sampled budget as a failed full solver
do not promote toy evidence to an exponent claim
invalidate if regeneration hashes or direct rho certificates fail
experiment.success_criterion: Both fresh curves have at least one accepted sub-full budget with exact projected support, held-out coverage, valid witnesses, full relation rank, and measured source/reconstruction reduction.
experiment.falsification_criterion: Either full control fails, or neither fresh curve has an accepted sub-full budget after declared costs.
